items.item: Payment proof upload attaches to registration
items.via: onboarding/payment-proof-approval.lifecycle — the full journey: registered client's purchased package is gated to pending → offline payment proof uploaded ATTACHES to that package (r2Key contains the packageInstanceId) → admin sees it in listPaymentProofs (approval queue) → confirmPayment + assignTrainer activates. Proof attaches to the package instance (the correct data model), not the bare registration form, which has no package to hang a payment against yet

items.item: Read availability: Google busy times block matching Avantej slots (pull-sync)
items.via: external_busy_blocks table (mig 0098) + listCalendarEvents + pullExternalBusyBlocks (idempotent upsert by connection+eventId, prunes stale, skips cancelled/free/all-day) + computeAvailableSlots subtracts blocks exactly like bookings + googleCalendar.pullAvailability proc (RBAC appointment_management:update). Unit: google-calendar-pull (4) + trainer-availability 'external busy blocks' (3). e2e: google-calendar/pull-availability.rule (endpoint wired + guarded + windowDays validation). mig 0098 needs prod-tenant rollout

items.item: Real Google OAuth round-trip (token exchange) + conflict resolution
items.why: oauth-initiate.rule proves the 302 to Google consent (calendar.events + userinfo.email, offline, signed state); the callback/token-exchange code exists but the live exchange needs a real Google Cloud OAuth app (CLIENT_ID/SECRET + registered redirect URI) — the only remaining external dependency. Conflict-resolution policy is a documented follow-up

items.item: Online card payments (Stripe)
Create/edit/delete Org→Region→Country→State→Location
Deletion blocked when node has active children
items.via: branch/delete-guard.rule — deleteNode defaults to BLOCK (autoDeleteChildren/autoReassignMembers false); a node with children or subtree members returns a typed 409 CONFLICT inside one transaction, leaving the whole subtree intact (no raw 500, no partial cascade). deleteHierarchyNode reassigns ALL subtree members up-front on the explicit cascade path
